message.content:
Below are a few well‑reviewed Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly dishes. All of them are located in the city proper (not in the suburbs) and have a good reputation for accommodating vegetarian diners.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* | Classic Thai menu; many dishes can be made vegetarian on request. |
| **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* | Same location as Baan Thai; offers a dedicated vegetarian menu. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* | Also shares the same building; vegetarian options are clearly marked. |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* | A popular spot with a vegetarian-friendly menu. |
| **Thai House** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* | Known for generous portions and vegetarian options. |

> **Tip:** All of the restaurants above are located on W 18th Street in the West Loop, so you can easily visit more than one in a single outing. If you prefer a different neighborhood, let me know and I can look for options in, say, the Near North Side or the Loop.

If you’d like to check availability for a reservation or want to confirm that a particular dish is vegetarian‑friendly, just let me know the date and time you’re planning to dine, and I can help you make a reservation.
